speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg. To begin my assessment, how severe is this pain on a scale of 1 to 10, and exactly where does the radiation travel?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sciatica (Lumbar Radiculopathy). The presentation of sudden, sharp lower back pain radiating down the leg to the foot in a 26-year-old female following exercise is highly consistent with nerve root irritation or compression. To confirm the specific level of involvement and rule out other causes, I will request MRI images of the lumbar spine. REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar_Spine_MRI.
